Master your career

Discover your postgraduate study options at UQ.
Explore postgrad

Study

Find study options to match your interests and learn how to get the most out of your time at UQ.

Research

Our research is creating change and making an impact on the world’s biggest challenges.

Partners and community

We collaborate locally and globally to drive innovation.

About UQ

We educate and work with outstanding people to build a better future.

Find a program

Browse study areas

Looking for a UQ expert?

We have experts across over 1,000 specialisations. Find a UQ researcher, PhD supervisor or media expert by searching UQ Experts.

Find an expert

Our campuses

Our campuses boast world-class facilities, beautiful outdoor areas, and a range of sporting and cultural amenities.

Apply now

View the steps to apply and get started on your application.

Scholarships

Apply for financial support to enrich your time at UQ and help you to focus on your studies.

One of the world's most respected universities

Top 50 worldwide

=40 in QS World University Rankings 2027

1

Graduate employability

#1 in Queensland for graduate employability

Leading innovation

#37 for Performance Ranking of Scientific Papers for World Universities 2025

See more rankings and facts

Steps toward reconciliation

Our Stretch Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP) aims to build a united, respectful community. It’s a steadfast commitment to work respectfully with and learn from Indigenous students, staff and communities to create a strong sense of belonging in an inclusive UQ.

Learn about reconciliation

Award-winning teachers 

The 2026 UQ Awards for Excellence in Teaching and Learning have been announced. The awards recognise and honour our educators' commitment to enhancing student learning and the overall student experience at UQ.

See our winners

See all events

ATAR Advice online event

Wondering what to do after you get your ATAR? Whether you’re seeking advice, information, or simply some reassurance, we can help.
